revisions.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached existing Aviator Veterans Day website artwork. Redesign its rendering and simplify the composition so it feels like a thoughtfully hand-drawn local North Carolina veterans-community fundraiser poster, made with ink, carved linocut shapes, and a small screen-print press. This is an aesthetic direction, not a claim of actual human or veteran authorship. Keep the bald eagle, upright American flag, one amber beer, propeller plane, and the exact three text blocks: 'AVIATOR BREWING COMPANY', 'VETERANS DAY', 'HONORING ALL WHO SERVED'. REMOVE THE HANGAR COMPLETELY: no building, brewery facade, architecture, windows or hangar signage anywhere. Keep one small vintage propeller plane quietly in the background along the bottom left, drawn as a restrained flat two-tone silhouette with a few hand-inked details; the plane must be secondary. Replace the cinematic scenery with warm cream uncoated paper and simple navy ink fields; limited four-ink palette of weathered navy, brick red, cream paper and muted beer amber. Make the eagle a distinctive economical woodcut illustration, grouped feather shapes, visible irregular inked edges, no photoreal feathers. Flag in the upper right with clear simple stripes and a correct recognizable canton, respectful and upright. A modest illustrated beer glass lower right in the same flat carved-ink style; no glossy glass, no condensation. Dominant confident condensed block/letterpress VETERANS DAY lettering, much simpler straight or gently arched line, slightly imperfect hand-set alignment. Brand smaller above, honoring line plainly typeset below; simplify or remove decorative laurels, ribbon effects and framing clutter. Deliberate negative space, slightly uneven line weights, subtle ink spread, sparse halftone texture and authentic print registration. Warm, direct, neighborly and dignified. Wide landscape 16:9 composition matching the reference, all wording and key objects safely inset 7% from edges, highly legible on mobile. Avoid AI-poster hallmarks: no fiery sunset, cinematic lighting, gradients, ornate gold filigree, beveled or extruded typography, lens effects, dramatic glow, hyper-detailed rendering, glossy photo collage, fake aging overload, extra lettering, invented event details, artist signatures or watermarks. Output one finished poster.
